notes.text: Depth census on a fresh chain outside the campaign slate, per instruction: money-corner/UNDISCOVERED links first (denied-party-screening-software reached TARGET_MET at exactly 5 distinct issuers with the same five names the chain's own capture_inputs already named as this niche's short vendor list; export-control-rulemaking and sovereign-veu-ai-buildouts, both UNDISCOVERED, closed EXHAUSTED with full multi-source records rather than left open, because their real public universe genuinely is 0 and 2 respectively, not under-searched), then the CHOKE_POINT link (sea-colocation-landlords, OPEN at 2/5: Equinix and GDS Holdings' DayOne platform placed with SEC-filing evidence, but the Bursa Malaysia and SGX listings this chain's own evidence names (YTL Power, Keppel DC REIT) could not get compliant official-exchange identity_evidence this run -- bursamalaysia.com returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and sgx.com/hkex.com.hk served only a JS-rendered shell with no extractable ticker data; queuing web_doc requests for those exact pages is the next step, not a second attempt at the same blocked fetch), then the rest as far as the evidence bar held: controlled-ai-accelerators and compliant-hyperscaler-cloud both reached TARGET_MET at 5 by adding one issuer each beyond the chain's own four example tickers (Marvell/Intel; IBM) with fresh SEC 10-K citations; chip-location-attestation closed EXHAUSTED at 1 (Nvidia is the only public developer of this exact technology, GeoComply is confirmed privately held); neocloud-gpu-rental stayed OPEN at 4/5 rather than force a weak fit (bitcoin-to-HPC pivots considered and rejected as not matching this link's specific GPU-rental role); china-hyperscaler-cloud-demand stayed OPEN at 1/5 (Tencent's only US instrument is an unsponsored OTC ADR with no SEC registrant found, and HKEX's own pages were not extractable this run).

WebSearch reached this session's budget cap early in the run; all research from that point forward used WebFetch directly against official sources (SEC EDGAR data.sec.gov and browse-edgar, company 10-K/20-F/40-F filings, UK Companies House, and named company/press primary sources already cited in the chain build) rather than discovery search. This is why non-US-only listings (London Stock Exchange Group plc/LSEG.L, considered for the denied-party-screening-software link but dropped in favor of NICE Ltd. once LSE's own market-data pages proved unreadable to WebFetch) and the Bursa Malaysia/SGX/HKEX names on sea-colocation-landlords and china-hyperscaler-cloud-demand could not be closed this run: every identity_evidence item actually placed is either a direct SEC EDGAR fetch (VERIFIED, OFFICIAL_REGULATOR) or a company's own SEC cover-page filing (VERIFIED, OFFICIAL_SECURITIES_FILING), never a paraphrase.

A live fetch this run confirms the SIC code 2741 is genuinely on the cover page, but as a separate field from the securities table, not adjacent to or joined with the Common Shares/TRI/Nasdaq row the way the recorded excerpt implies; the 'Miscellaneous Publishing' description and 'foreign private issuer' designation do not appear anywhere in this document's text at all (the cover page's raw extracted text shows 'Common Shares', 'TRI', and 'The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC' as three separate table cells on separate lines, joined with a ' | ' delimiter in the recorded excerpt that is not present in the source). This is a composite-tabular excerpt with no excerpt_form: composite-tabular marker (method section 1's required flag for this citation shape), and the claim additionally overstates what the cited cover page itself states. Fix in a later run universe: mark the securities-table excerpt excerpt_form: composite-tabular with fields in true reading order, cite the SIC 2741 figure separately as its own span, and drop or re-source the 'Miscellaneous Publishing' and 'foreign private issuer' language, neither of which is stated in this filing's own text.

run universe-audit neocloud-export-compliance --placement NICE-LTD (fresh context, batch run c-paudits-chip-cloud): sampled evidence[0] on link denied-party-screening-software. identity_ok true, role_ok false, source_date_ok true; status FAIL. placement evidence[0].source_excerpt is recorded as the exact phrase 'Financial Crime and Compliance Solutions' (with ordinary word spacing), presented as if it were a verbatim span of the filing's running text describing an operating segment. A live fetch and full-text search of the filing this run found no such space-separated phrase anywhere in the document's narrative prose or headings; the only place the constituent words appear together at all is concatenated without spaces inside an XBRL element identifier, 'us-gaap:OperatingSegmentsMembernice:FinancialCrimeAndComplianceSolutionsMember' (this audit's own source_excerpt above), which is machine-readable tag metadata a reader would not encounter as prose. The underlying fact, that NICE Ltd. operates a Financial Crime and Compliance business line, is real and independently corroborated by NICE's own public product and press pages (niceactimize.com, nice.com), but those are not the cited SEC filing and were not the source recorded. Fix in a later run universe: re-cite to a source that actually contains this phrase as running text (NICE's own investor materials, an earnings-call transcript, or 20-F segment-reporting prose, re-fetched and confirmed), or accurately describe the XBRL tag as machine metadata rather than filing prose.

Fix in a later run universe: either re-cite the board-seat clause to the April 2024 Microsoft newsroom announcement (news.microsoft.com) that actually states it (as an explicit second span or second evidence item), or drop the board-seat language from this placement's role and claim if only the November 2025 source is to be cited.
